SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, sum(yt) as yt, count(*) as n_trips, sum(anglers) as anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy >= 60
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT fish_date_doy, sum(yt) as yt, count(*) as n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 0 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 75 AND 110
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
